16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

3171|9d35dc4d.name: Thotar
3171|9d35dc4d.text: I train and guide young hunters in the traditions passed down many generations.

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3389|5612724d.name: Regthar Deathgate
3389|5612724d.text: We have our duties, $c.  Duties to the Horde.

3549|2cec462d.name: Shelene Rhobart
3549|2cec462d.text: Skin, glorious skin. It holds your insides... in. You might've noticed my skin's not doing so well. To think I used to worry about my pores. Hardly any skin left to worry about these days. In a way, it's very freeing.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

5750|721fd095.name: Gina Lang
5750|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

658|003beda2.name: Sten Stoutarm
658|003beda2.text: Ah, well aren't you a sturdy-looking one? Perhaps you can assist me with a thing or two. Not much help around here except for green apprentices, and they've other things to worry about.

916|4968a15c.name: Solm Hargrin
916|4968a15c.text: What kin I do for ye, $N?

1109-accept.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
1109-accept.text:
As you can see, $N, we're up to some very.... interesting experiments at the Royal Apothecary Society.

As the Master here, it is my job to oversee the most ambitious of our alchemical attempts. So much work and so little time!

You look well traveled for a $c. Perhaps you can aid me.

I'm in need of a rare substance. It's foul material; it comes from a rare species of bats only found in the muck-hole known as Razorfen Kraul. Bring to me the guano from the Kraul Bats so we can begin our work...
1109-accept.title: Going, Going, Guano!

1361-complete.name: Regthar Deathgate
1361-complete.text: Yes, I am recruiting.  This mission leads into Desolace, against the centaur there.  I will be brief so that you may quickly begin.
1361-complete.title: Regthar Deathgate

1362-accept.name: Regthar Deathgate
1362-accept.text:
The Kolkar centaur live in Desolace, and their forces have spread into the Barrens.  This is a known fact and we have Horde agents dealing with them here.

But as long as the centaur are strong in Desolace, they will always pose a threat.  It is time we rid ourselves of that threat.

Speak with Felgur Twocuts at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace.  He was sent to gather intelligence on the centaur.  He will know how to best deal with the Kolkar of Desolace.
1362-accept.title: The Kolkar of Desolace

1431-accept.name: Craven Drok
1431-accept.text:
Be still, $c, and allow me to share with you something important to our people, but far from obvious.

We are a proud race, and the war with the humans tried even Thrall's great patience. You see, our Warchief is wise and prudent, and he continues to put his people first. Ultimately, he is a diplomat, and in his time with the humans he learned much of their ways.

If the tale I've started piques your interest, then find Keldran near the western exit of the city. His hovel is there.
1431-accept.title: Alliance Relations

1471-accept.name: Carendin Halgar
1471-accept.text:
Surely you have seen the circle of summoning below us? Only there will you be able to draw forth an unbound voidwalker.

Using these runes, you will be able to draw it forth, and then you must dominate it through strength of arms and magic.

When it is subdued, it will be indentured to you. Come to me then, and I will elucidate the spell of summoning, so that it may serve you to whatever end you wish.
1471-accept.title: The Binding

1471-complete.name: Carendin Halgar
1471-complete.text:
You have done well, $N. Now, I will impart to you the spell used for summoning the voidwalker.

The power that it unleashed upon you is now yours to command. Use it wisely.
1471-complete.title: The Binding

1471-progress.name: Carendin Halgar
1471-progress.text: I expect to hear of your success, $N. Not meeting my expectations will be the least of your worries, however, should you fail.
1471-progress.title: The Binding

1473-accept.name: Carendin Halgar
1473-accept.text:
It seems the consensus that you are ready to learn to summon a voidwalker.

A being created of the chaos that lies beyond, if you summon one but cannot control it, you will be torn asunder.

The first voidwalker was summoned by Egalin, and in his grimoire is the process explained.

Unfortunately, it was stolen from us by an agent of the Scarlet Crusade who has it secreted away in his base at a tower to the west. Bring it to me, and I will impart the knowledge to you.
1473-accept.title: Creature of the Void

1473-complete.name: Carendin Halgar
1473-complete.text:
Ah, this is excellent. Like as not, Perrine was ignorant to the true power of the musty book he had stolen from us.

It will not fall out of our hands again. Observe, $N, the structure of the spell, the manner in which your power must be channeled.
1473-complete.title: Creature of the Void

1473-progress.name: Carendin Halgar
1473-progress.text:
Egalin was the teacher that taught me. With hardly a look, he was able to command the voidwalker he had summoned.

When it came my turn to try, I was overconfident. Do not trifle with the powers that you wield, $N, they can consume even the vigilant.
1473-progress.title: Creature of the Void

1478-accept.name: Ageron Kargal
1478-accept.text:
Ah, $N! I just received word from Carendin Halgar that he would like to see you for further training.

You should be proud of yourself, $N. It's not every day that Master Halgar personally sees fit to instruct a young $c.

You'll be able to find him in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, near the Temple of the Damned.
1478-accept.title: Halgar's Summons

1478-complete.name: Carendin Halgar
1478-complete.text: Good, I see Ageron managed to find you, $N. Let us waste little time with small talk and pleasantries and focus on your training. There is still much you have to learn.
1478-complete.title: Halgar's Summons

170-accept.name: Balir Frosthammer
170-accept.text:
I hope you're here to lend us a hand, $c. After the last trogg attack, we could use all the help we can get.

I hear the buggers have been popping up all across the lands, and it seems Coldridge Valley is no exception. They've been spotted all over the hills to the southeast and near the frozen lake.

And that's not all, just a few nights ago, they attacked and overran our camp to the west! 

We're a bit shorthanded here, lad, and we need strong arms to help drive the troggs back.
170-accept.title: A New Threat

1712-accept.name: Bath'rah the Windwatcher
1712-accept.text:
I have spent ages watching this site.  I watch, so that one day I might see the great Cyclonian fall.  But I have not yet found a champion to defeat the wind lord.

Perhaps you are that champion.

Prove it to me.  Gather the items I need to summon Cyclonian, and I will know you are a great $c.  Perhaps then you can defeat him and gain his whirlwind heart.

If so, then I will infuse the heart's power in a weapon, and I will give that weapon to you.

Here is a parchment with the items I need.
1712-accept.title: Cyclonian

1718-complete.name: Klannoc Macleod
1718-complete.text: Hello, $c.  It's good to see you made it to Fray Island.  I hope you find it to your liking...
1718-complete.title: The Islander

1719-accept.name: Klannoc Macleod
1719-accept.text:
If you want to learn from me, then you must first pass The Affray.  It is a challenge we on Fray Island like to offer rising warriors who think they're tough, and if you can pass this test then I'll know you are.

To begin, walk into the middle of that crowd yonder and step on the grate.  That'll tell Twiggy Flathead you're ready, and he'll send challengers against you.

Beat all the challengers and he'll call out Big Will.  Kill Big Will, and return to me in the time we allow.
1719-accept.title: The Affray

1719-complete.name: Klannoc Macleod
1719-complete.text:
Well done, $N.  You have passed The Affray!

You are a worthy $c, and I am honored to teach you...
1719-complete.title: The Affray

179-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-accept.text:
What do we have here? You look as though you might need something to keep your hands warm, hm?

I'll tell you what would help: a pair of nice, warm gloves. And, being the kind soul that I am, I'd be more than happy to provide you with a suitable pair. I've one condition, however.

I need you to go get me some wolf meat. Nice arrangement, hm? You bring me some wolf meat, and I'll make sure you don't lose any digits to frostbite. Well, what do you say?
179-accept.title: Dwarven Outfitters

179-complete.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-complete.text: Ah! Wonderful. The wolf meat should do nicely. Oh, don't worry, $N, I wouldn't forget my part of the bargain. Here, one of these should fit you.
179-complete.title: Dwarven Outfitters

179-progress.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-progress.text: Wolves giving you a bit of trouble? You'd do well to avoid the fangs and claws and other sharp bits, yes?
179-progress.title: Dwarven Outfitters

1791-accept.name: Klannoc Macleod
1791-accept.text:
Now that you've learned your berserker's stance, you'll want a nice weapon to use it with.

Talk to Bath'rah the Windwatcher, a troll hermit who lives between the Alterac Mountains and the Western Plaguelands.  He is a skilled weapon maker and a powerful shaman.

To find Bath'rah, go to the river that flows along Tarren Mill's eastern flank.  Follow it north--Bath'rah is camped near ruins that rest along the river's eastern bank.
1791-accept.title: The Windwatcher

1791-complete.name: Bath'rah the Windwatcher
1791-complete.text:
You have traveled far, young $c.  I see fire in your eyes.  You seek a weapon of great power, yes?

I can help you with your quest.  And you can help me with mine.
1791-complete.title: The Windwatcher

233-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
233-accept.text:
Hm, I don't suppose you'd be willing to do a favor for me, lad? A stack of letters came through the pass today, but I don't have the time to send them along.

They're all addressed to Talin Keeneye. You can find him to the west down the road. He's set up camp next to the frozen lake.

What do you say?
233-accept.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

3113-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
3113-accept.text: While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the $c trainer Solm. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
3113-accept.title: Encrypted Memorandum

3113-complete.name: Solm Hargrin
3113-complete.text:
I pretty much keep to myself around here so we don't get a bad rap for things gone missing, but if you need anything, some training or somethin', just come back anytime.

You and me got an understandin'. We know when it comes down to it you can only trust family... and that's just what we got going on here, isn't it? Regardless of Gnomeregan being... overrun, and whatever else is thrown our way, we got one another to back each other up. Right?
3113-complete.title: Encrypted Memorandum

3113-progress.name: Solm Hargrin
3113-progress.text:
Glad to see you got my note and came over. Sorry about pretendin' it was a memorandum from your higher-ups... no offense intended. I just knew the two of us, along with others of our kind, gotta stick together.

Not many think it's the best thing in the world to have your kind and my kind holed up in the same city, but I think we can work things out just fine. What do you think?
3113-progress.title: Encrypted Memorandum

354-complete.name: Coleman Farthing
354-complete.text:
Revenge has a sweet taste, don't you think?  When you destroyed the Agamands, did you catch any hint of free will within them?  I hope so.  I hope they knew fear before they were smashed into oblivion.

It is a foolish hope, I know.  But it is a hope I foster nonetheless.
354-complete.title: Deaths in the Family

354-progress.name: Coleman Farthing
354-progress.text: Do you have the remains of the Agamands?  Are those cursed beasts finally destroyed?
354-progress.title: Deaths in the Family

355-accept.name: Coleman Farthing
355-accept.text:
You have given me the remains of the Agamands, and satisfied my desire for revenge.  But the Agamand Mills hold a threat to all the Forsaken, not just to me.

I have spoken to Magistrate Sevren of your exploits against the Agamands, and he wishes to speak with you.
355-accept.title: Speak with Sevren

355-complete.name: Magistrate Sevren
355-complete.text:
Coleman speaks well of you, $N, telling of your successful forays into the Agamand Mills.

The Forsaken have need of your talents once again...
355-complete.title: Speak with Sevren

357-accept.name: Bethor Iceshard
357-accept.text:
There is a lich who dwells on the island in Brightwater Lake to the north.  Although he is a free-willed Forsaken, he believes all other $R are Scourge slaves and has his minions attack anyone who approaches him.

But because he is Forsaken, the Queen will want him.  And if he is skilled in Necromancy, then his knowledge would be...quite useful to us.

To discover his identity and his talents, I must see his spellbook.  Steal into his camp and acquire it, then return to me.
357-accept.title: The Lich's Identity

357-complete.name: Bethor Iceshard
357-complete.text:
Very good, $N.  I will study this book and determine the identity of that lich.  You have served your Queen well.

<Bethor opens the book and stares intently at its glowing pages...>

Astonishing!  The book you retrieved belongs to no one other than Gunther Arcanus!

Gunther was a skilled Necromancer in life; he and I were friends and comrades-in-arms, before the Plague.  And judging from his book he has grown even more powerful in death.

His skills would be a great boon to us.
357-complete.title: The Lich's Identity

362-complete.name: Coleman Farthing
362-complete.text:
Thank you.  Devlin's bones will rest nicely on my mantle.

If my cold heart can find warmth, it is in knowing that the Agamands are destroyed.  They failed me and my family when the Plague came - now I swear I will smash their remains under my heel!
362-complete.title: The Haunted Mills

366-accept.name: Bethor Iceshard
366-accept.text:
Long ago Gunther and I, along with the now Scourge Necromancer Thule Ravenclaw, were friends and students within the Kirin Tor - a society of mages in Dalaran.

Gunther and I both fell to the Plague, but I thought he either remained dead, or was raised into the ranks of the Lich King.  It is good to know he is free.

We must have him.  I have placed a spell on his book that, when he sees it, will show him that I too am free of the Lich King.  After knowing this, it is my hope that he will join us.
366-accept.title: Return the Book

366-complete.name: Gunther Arcanus
366-complete.text:
My book?!?  So you were the thief who stole it!

But...what is this new enchantment upon it...Bethor?  He is in  Lordaeron?

If he still exists, then perhaps he too escaped from the Lich King's grasp...
366-complete.title: Return the Book

366-progress.name: Gunther Arcanus
366-progress.text: Your masters are fools to send you here, for I will never again be a Scourge slave!
366-progress.title: Return the Book

370-complete.name: Executor Zygand
370-complete.text: Captain Perrine's death will undoubtedly please The Dark Lady.  You have performed your duty well, $c.
370-complete.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

371-accept.name: Executor Zygand
371-accept.text:
We are still at war and the Scarlet Crusade grows in strength.  The report Executor Arren sent me indicates Scarlet Crusaders have been raiding from the ruined tower in southeastern Tirisfal near the Balnir Farmstead under the command of Captain Vachon.

Kill Vachon along with 5 Scarlet Friars. It should prove to be a devastating blow to the Crusade!
371-accept.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

374-complete.name: Deathguard Burgess
374-complete.text: Varimathras would be proud.  You serve your leaders well, $c.
374-complete.title: Proof of Demise

374-progress.name: Deathguard Burgess
374-progress.text: Have you collected 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings yet, $c?
374-progress.title: Proof of Demise

405-complete.name: Bethor Iceshard
405-complete.text:
Ah, you are the agent sent by Magistrate Sevren.  Then yes, your business with me is crucial.

I trust Sevren has mustered someone suitable for my task...but we shall see.
405-complete.title: The Prodigal Lich

405-progress.name: Bethor Iceshard
405-progress.text:
Greetings.  Either you do not know who I am, or your business with me is urgent.

Because if neither of these were true, then you would not be foolish enough to disturb me...
405-progress.title: The Prodigal Lich

408-accept.name: Magistrate Sevren
408-accept.text:
The Agamand Mills area has become a foothold for the Scourge.  Their strongest point is the Agamand Family Crypt where their local military leader, a skeleton named Captain Dargol, has headquartered.  With Necromancy he has raised the ancestors of the Agamands and plans to use them against us.

This cannot pass, and you must stop it.  Travel to the Agamand Family Crypt and defeat the raised Agamand ancestors.

And, bring me the skull of Captain Dargol.
408-accept.title: The Family Crypt

409-accept.name: Gunther Arcanus
409-accept.text:
You say you are not bound by the will of the Lich King, and the enchantment Bethor placed upon my book corroborates this.  But before I believe you I must have proof that you are enemy to the Scourge.

There is an old, bloody altar just off the southern coast of this island.  it is used by a powerful Scourge agent, Lillith Nefara.

Take a Candle of Beckoning from this crate here.  Light it on the altar and Lillith will awake.  Destroy Lillith, and I will believe you are the Lich King's foe.
409-accept.title: Proving Allegiance

409-complete.name: Gunther Arcanus
409-complete.text:
You have defeated Lillith Nefara, proving you are an enemy of the Scourge.  Incredible.

I had believed I was the only $R with free will, but you have shown me there are others who have broken the Lich King's domination.
409-complete.title: Proving Allegiance

410-complete.name: Unknown
410-complete.text: You place the Candle of Beckoning upon the table and light it...
410-complete.title: The Dormant Shade

410-progress.name: Unknown
410-progress.text: This is an old, beaten, bloody table.
410-progress.title: The Dormant Shade

411-accept.name: Gunther Arcanus
411-accept.text: Take this Nether Gem to my old comrade Bethor.  It will let us communicate ... and I have much to tell him.
411-accept.title: The Prodigal Lich Returns

411-complete.name: Bethor Iceshard
411-complete.text: You convinced him to join us!  You have done a great deed for the Forsaken, $N.  The Dark Lady will be informed.
411-complete.title: The Prodigal Lich Returns

411-progress.name: Bethor Iceshard
411-progress.text: Have you returned Gunther's book?  Has he responded?
411-progress.title: The Prodigal Lich Returns

426-complete.name: Deathguard Dillinger
426-complete.text: Your efforts in the war are felt among us, $N.  I will not thank you for doing what is necessary, but the Deathguards of Tirisfal will remember your name.
426-complete.title: The Mills Overrun

426-progress.name: Deathguard Dillinger
426-progress.text: Our battles with the Scourge wage on, $N.  Do your part and throw those cursed, mindless $r back into the Plaguelands!
426-progress.title: The Mills Overrun

431-complete.name: Unknown
431-complete.text: You grab one of the candles and place it in your pack.
431-complete.title: Candles of Beckoning

513-complete.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
513-complete.text:
Apothecary Lydon sent you?  Ah, why didn't you say so!

Despite his gloomy disposition, Apothecary Lydon is one of our most dedicated and skilled members.

The good chap sends Mudsnout Composite!  I know what our friend in Hillsbrad is up to now.  And I like the way he thinks.  The Dark Lady would be most impressed with the progress he is making toward the new plague.
513-complete.title: Elixir of Agony

513-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
513-progress.text: Can you not see I am busy, $c?  The Dark Lady insists on a new plague before the Scourge advance from Northrend overwhelms us.  And with the human threat pressing from the south, time becomes my most precious commodity.  This better be important!
513-progress.title: Elixir of Agony

515-accept.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
515-accept.text:
A mudsnout composite?  Absolutely brilliant!  Why didn't I think of that?

Let me contribute my colloid of decay to this devilish brew.

In order to activate the contaminating agents in this mudsnout mixture, Lydon is going to need a strong troll's blood elixir, as well as some daggerspine scales and torn fin eyes from the southern coast of Hillsbrad.  He'll know what to do once you've gathered him all the reagents.  And my, how anxious I am to hear how his experiment goes!
515-accept.title: Elixir of Agony

786-complete.name: Lar Prowltusk
786-complete.text:
The Horde would surely prevail if the Kolkar centaurs were to attack. But by preventing such an attack, we have spared our mighty warriors unnecessary bloodshed.

And as sure as there is sand in the Tanaris desert, we know that there will be blood spilled before these trying times are through.

You have served your people well, $c.
786-complete.title: Thwarting Kolkar Aggression

79095-progress.name: Owen Thadd
79095-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79095-progress.title: The Apothecary's Metaphysical Primer

818-complete.name: Master Vornal
818-complete.text: Well done, young one... well done indeed.
818-complete.title: A Solvent Spirit

818-progress.name: Master Vornal
818-progress.text: Time is the true test of your strength and will. Lose patience or give in to weakness, and your true self will be shown.
818-progress.title: A Solvent Spirit

97558-progress.name: Shelene Rhobart
97558-progress.text:
Have you gathered the skin I inquired about? Our stocks are running low.

It may seem odd to ask for murloc skin but it works well for internal membranes, or surfaces like cheeks or mouths.

Similarly, the duskbat wing membranes are especially suited for more delicate areas, like faces or fingers. It prevents the skin from being too... thick.
97558-progress.title: Hides for the Forsaken
